data: What is the value represented by the darkest-colored cell in the confusion matrix shown in Figure 5?

The darkest-colored cell in the confusion matrix corresponds to the value of 0.0 on the color scale. This can be verified by checking the color bar on the right side of the figure, which shows a gradient from yellow (representing values close to 0.8) through pink and purple to dark blue (representing values close to 0.0). The darkest blue cell in the matrix aligns with the value 0.0 on this scale. Therefore, the value represented by the darkest-colored cell is 0.0.
